title: (BREAKING) Remove offline & rxjs support from framework

## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->

Removes esm-offline, esm-offline-app, and rxjs from underlying APIs. Offline support has been out of date for a while, i.e., our version of `dexie` is 6-years old and the version of Workbox no longer really works with the current setup at all. Similarly, while providing rxjs via the framework made sense several years ago, we're now on a very old version that is likely holding back any consumers that would actually use rxjs. Since `Promises` can be trivially converted to `Observables` losslessly, especially given how we used them, this should allow downstream apps to independently update their rxjs version.

Retains a small compatibility shim with the most commonly-used public functions now stubbed. These deprecated shims will be removed in a future version.

There is a small implementation of subscribable notifications added to esm-styleguide to support the notification system.
